requirements.title_zh: 构建世界级AI创新生态体系
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
任务书补充交付：案例、遗址公园与运营转化
requirements.evidence_note_zh: 生态体系的证据是三个实验室承担三项互不相同的任务，而不是一句总口号；三张任务分工图版与三项公开登记类行动是可核对的落点。 确切依据：章节 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究、AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景、任务书补充交付：案例、遗址公园与运营转化；图纸 drawings/a0-boards.pdf；图层 geometry/key_areas.geojson、geometry/land_use.geojson；指标 key_area_count、official_overall_design_area_sqm；来源 OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT、AGENT-TASKBOOK、CASE-ONE-NORTH、CASE-SEOUL-AI-HUB、CASE-PARIS-SACLAY、CASE-MILA；假设 A-PILOT-001；自检 PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE；图版 ZZY-01、AIO-01、DZS-01；行动 P04、P05、P09。
requirements.evidence_note_en: The ecosystem claim is evidenced by three labs carrying three different tasks rather than by one slogan; the three distinct-task plates and three public-registry actions are the checkable landing points. Exact references: sections 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究, AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景, 任务书补充交付：案例、遗址公园与运营转化; drawings drawings/a0-boards.pdf; layers geometry/key_areas.geojson, geometry/land_use.geojson; metrics key_area_count, official_overall_design_area_sqm; sources OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT, AGENT-TASKBOOK, CASE-ONE-NORTH, CASE-SEOUL-AI-HUB, CASE-PARIS-SACLAY, CASE-MILA; assumptions A-PILOT-001; self-checks PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE; plates ZZY-01, AIO-01, DZS-01; actions P04, P05, P09.

requirements.evidence_note_en: The new urban form is claimed only at the level of a Phase 1 reversible envelope; the three envelope plates show a withdrawable support structure, not an approved development quantum. AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景

requirements.evidence_note_en: The ecosystem lands spatially as three tables — register, correct, appeal; the two Ostrom entries supply governance context only and name no operator. Exact references: sections 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究, AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/key_areas.geojson; metrics key_area_count; sources AGENT-TASKBOOK, CASE-ONE-NORTH, CASE-MILA, OSTROM-COMMONS-1990, OSTROM-POLYCENTRIC-2010; assumptions A-PILOT-001; self-checks PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE; plates AIO-01, AIO-02, AIO-05; components O-C01, O-C02, O-C05; actions P04, P05, P09.

requirements.title_zh: 统筹研究范围：适配人工智能的未来城市形态

总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
requirements.evidence_note_zh: 未来城市形态的四个指标全部来自对手工申报候选边的种子化 Kruskal 拓扑与选择不稳定性探针，不代表交通需求、可达性或最优性。 确切依据：章节 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究、总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计；图纸 drawings/a3-booklet.pdf；图层 geometry/land_use.geojson、geometry/roads.geojson；指标 persistent_corridor_count、disagreement_corridor_count、network_detour_factor、mean_persistent_frequency；来源 CAS-DYNAMIC-CITIES-2018、PORTUGALI-SELF-ORGANIZING-1997、HOLLING-1973、SCHELLING-1971、PHYSARUM-TOKYO-2010；假设 A-NETWORK-001、A-WEIGHTS-001；自检 DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION。
requirements.evidence_note_en: All four metrics come from the seeded Kruskal topology and selection-instability probe over hand-declared candidate edges; none of them represents demand, accessibility, or optimality. Exact references: sections 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究, 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计; drawings drawings/a3-booklet.pdf; layers geometry/land_use.geojson, geometry/roads.geojson; metrics persistent_corridor_count, disagreement_corridor_count, network_detour_factor, mean_persistent_frequency; sources CAS-DYNAMIC-CITIES-2018, PORTUGALI-SELF-ORGANIZING-1997, HOLLING-1973, SCHELLING-1971, PHYSARUM-TOKYO-2010; assumptions A-NETWORK-001, A-WEIGHTS-001; self-checks DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION.
